title: India 🇮🇳: where is your $100 worth more? 3 rounds
headline: Your $100 in *India*?
description: Bring $100 to India and it buys what $435 buys in America. Is that more than in China, Pakistan or Egypt? Real World Bank data (2025, price-adjusted). India or Egypt? Comment your flag.
source: World Bank: GDP per person in US dollars and adjusted for prices (PPP), 2025, data.worldbank.org

hi.title: भारत 🇮🇳: आपके $100 कहाँ ज़्यादा चलते हैं? 3 राउंड
hi.description: भारत में $100 उतना खरीदते हैं जितना अमेरिका में $435। चीन, पाकिस्तान या मिस्र से ज़्यादा? असली आंकड़े। अपना झंडा कमेंट करें।

segments.text: Your hundred dollars in India. Is it worth more than in China?
India. It buys what four hundred thirty-five dollars buys in America.
India again. By just twenty-three dollars.
Egypt. Six hundred fifty-five dollars. Prices there are even lower.
India or Egypt? Comment your flag.
